bullets.text: AI Try-On Revolutionized - **Google**'s new feature allows virtual clothing fitting using just a selfie.
Shazam's Popular Segments - New feature highlights song moments that capture user attention.
Epic Games Wins Again - **Fortnite** returns to the US **Google Play Store** after court ruling.
Disney's AI Partnership - **Disney** teams up with **OpenAI** for user-generated content using beloved characters.
Rivian's AI Assistant - **Rivian** to launch its AI assistant in early 2026 for all existing EVs.
Tomb Raider Returns - Two new **Tomb Raider** games announced for 2026 and 2027.
Google's AI Research Agent - **Google** launches a new AI research agent, Gemini Deep Research.
New Star Wars Game - **Star Wars: Galactic Racer** announced for 2026, focusing on racing.
1X Humanoids for Factories - **1X** partners to deploy humanoid robots in industrial settings.
OpenAI's GPT-5.2 Launch - **OpenAI** releases its latest model amid fierce competition with **Google**.
